title: FieldEng + ProServices weekly: client onboarding pulse (2026-03-24)
content:
Meeting: Field Engineering + Professional Services weekly sync
Date: 2026-03-24
Time: 10:00–11:00 PT (Notes taken by Ava Chen)
Attendees: Ava Chen (owner), Diego Martinez, Priya Kapoor, Liam O'Neill, Sofia Ramos, guest: Maya Patel (Customer Success)
Absentees: N/A
Objective: quick status on live customer integrations, risks that need exec attention, and action items for next sprint. Keep to 15m per customer.

Agenda:
- Quick wins / escalations (5m)
- Customer updates (35m)
- Open action items and owners (10m)
- Parking lot / follow-ups (remaining)

Quick wins / escalations:
- Observability: new per-request tracing was rolled out to Dedicated clusters last night (canary). Initial metrics show 20% lower time-to-first-byte for requests under 256 tokens. Diego to publish measurements to the metrics dashboard by EOD Wed.
- Billing edge-case: we saw 2 accounts with anomalous embedding charges after a caching change; Finance alerted PS. Root cause: cache-key normalization bug in the prefix cache; patch merged to staging (PR #198). Priya to coordinate remedial credits with Finance.

Customer updates (priority order):

1) Orchid Health (mid-market, healthcare) — Status: staging validation
- Current phase: verification of VPC peering + KMS integration in staging.
- Done since last week: test prompts, token-level billing correlation, SSO proof-of-concept.
- Blockers: security requires Hardware-backed KMS (HSM) for key wrap; Redwood private KMS adapter needs HSM integration (SEC ticket created).
- Risk: timeline slip to production by 1 week if KMS sign-off delayed.
- Next milestone: complete HSM integration (internal) and run customer smoke tests.
- Owner / action: Liam -> finalize HSM adapter design doc and open review by 2026-03-30 (linked: CONFLUENCE-Client-Onboarding-Playbook-423).

2) Atlas Retail (scale e-comm) — Status: canary rollout in prod
- Current phase: canary rollout (10% traffic) on Dedicated pool.
- Done: latency SLOs meet targets for 95th pct under baseline traffic; batching config tuned.
- Blockers: occasional KV cache misses under bursty loads causing retries; SRE investigating autoscaler cooldown thresholds.
- Ask: product wants a short one-pager on recommended batching/caching knobs for Atlas-like workloads to present to their infra team.
- Owner / action: Diego -> draft batching one-pager and share in Slack by 2026-03-26.

3) StratusBank (enterprise, finance) — Status: security review
- Current phase: final security checklist and audit items.
- Done: network diagrams, control-plane isolation docs submitted.
- Blockers: customer audit requires 90-day retention of request logs; this conflicts with our default 30-day TTL in hosted logs. Compliance asked for an exception or architecture change.
- Risk: potential deal delay if retention architecture not approved.
- Owner / action: Priya -> escalate to legal/compliance and propose architecture options with estimated infra cost by 2026-03-29. Also schedule a sync with the customer's security lead.

4) NimbusEd (SaaS, education) — Status: pilot prep
- Current phase: integration runbook creation and readiness checklist.
- Done: training session held for customer's dev team, sample prompts and eval sets delivered.
- Blockers: none critical; small ask for example prompt templates for multilingual content.
- Owner / action: Sofia -> assemble 6-8 multilingual prompt templates and upload to shared Confluence by 2026-03-28.

Operational / cross-customer notes:
- Canary guardrails: reminder that canary rollbacks must be automated when 5xx or latency breach occurs for 3 consecutive 5-minute windows. Ops playbook PR referenced in linked_artifacts.
- Runbook gaps found: two runbooks (KMS onboarding, Dedicated pool autoscale) need clearer run sequence for customer-facing handoffs; flagged for rewrite.
- Documentation: customers keep asking for a short 'why quantize' explainer for non-ML engineers — create a 1-page FAQ.

Open action items (summary):
- Liam O'Neill: HSM adapter design doc + review (due 2026-03-30).
- Diego Martinez: publish canary latency metrics and draft batching one-pager (due 2026-03-26).
- Priya Kapoor: escalate StratusBank retention question to legal, propose options + costs, schedule customer security sync (due 2026-03-29).
- Sofia Ramos: multilingual prompt templates for NimbusEd (due 2026-03-28).
- Ava Chen: prepare PS update slides for Sales Ops (5 slides) summarizing top 3 risks + mitigation (due 2026-03-27).
- Team: review and comment on PR #198 (ops-playbooks) to finalize rollback automation (requested by 2026-03-26).

Notes to self / meeting observations:
- Keep the customer-facing status short and include explicit "next milestone" in every update. Buyers appreciate predicted date ranges.
- For security-sensitive customers, explicitly call out dependencies on Legal/Compliance as action items so Sales can set expectations.
- Consider a recurring 30-minute "KMS and Keys" deep dive every other week until HSM onboarding is stable across customers. Proposed cadence: biweekly, starting 2026-04-07.

Parking lot / topics for follow-up:
- Add a lightweight SLA appendix template for pilot customers that want predictable latency but not full enterprise SLA.
- Investigate automating the remediation credits flow for billing anomalies (Finance -> API that can trigger credits).
- Build a compact 'what to expect during rollout' checklist for customers (one-pager).

Next meeting: 2026-03-31 10:00 PT

Raw links and references (handy):
- Confluence: Client Onboarding Playbook: CONFLUENCE-Client-Onboarding-Playbook-423
- Jira PS epic: JIRA-PS-8175 (contains per-customer tickets)
- Ops playbook PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops-playbooks/pull/198
- Slack thread: #ps-field-eng thread-CA12345678

Document history:
- Created 2026-03-24 by Ava Chen
- Minor edits 2026-03-25 (added canary metrics note and updated Atlas status)

If anything missing or mis-stated, reply inline or add comments on this doc.

-- end of notes --
